subject: ROOM #16
text: In ROOM #16, there are open doors to the West to ROOM #17 and the East to ROOM #18.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #16:
    There are no enemies in this room. Just two sets of tiles which 
    will reveal two sets of four hearts if you need them. There are 
    open doors to the West and ROOM #17 and the East to ROOM #18.

subject: ROOM #16
text: In ROOM #16, two sets of tiles reveal two sets of four hearts.

evidence.quote: ROOM #16: There are no enemies in this room. Just two sets of tiles which will reveal two sets of four hearts if you need them.

subject: triceratops
text: In ROOM #17, defeat the triceratops to open the East door back to ROOM #16.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #17:
    There is a triceratops in this room that you must defeat to open 
    the East door back to ROOM #16.

subject: ROOM #17
text: In ROOM #17, there is a medicine in the upper west corner of the room.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #17: ... There is also a medicine in the 
    upper west corner of the room.

subject: triceratops
text: In ROOM #18, defeat both triceratops to open the door to the West and ROOM #20.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #18:
    This room has two triceratops. Defeat both of them to open the door 
    to the West and ROOM #20.

subject: tile
text: In ROOM #18, a tile will open the room to the North and ROOM #19.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #18: ... There is also a tile in this room that 
    will open the room to the North and ROOM #19.

subject: skull heads
text: In ROOM #19, defeat the two skull heads on the raised section to open the door to the West and ROOM #22.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #19:
    This room has two skull heads up on a raised section of the room. 
    Defeat them to open the door to the West and ROOM #22.

subject: question mark
text: In ROOM #20, jumping on the correct tile reveals a medicine and question mark surrounded by flames, and the question mark opens the wall to the East and ROOM #21.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #20: ... In the center of the room are 
    tiles but be careful as there are flames that surround the 
    medicine and question mark you can make appear by jumping on the 
    correct tile. The question mark will open the wall to the East and 
    ROOM #21.

subject: ROOM #21
text: In ROOM #21, there are six bats and spike balls in the corner.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #21:
    There are six bats in this room and some spike balls in the corner.

subject: ROOM #21
text: From ROOM #21, head back West to ROOM #18 and then North to ROOM #19.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #21: ... You can defeat the bats if you wish otherwise grab the spike balls 
    and head back West to ROOM #18 and then North to ROOM #19.

subject: armored knights
text: In ROOM #22, defeat the two armored knights to open the wall to the West and ROOM #23.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #22:
    There are two armored knights in this room. Defeat them to open the 
    wall to the West and ROOM #23.

subject: rock guys
text: In ROOM #23, defeat all four rock guys to open the wall to the West and ROOM #24.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #23:
    There are four rock guys in this room as well as four patches of 
    tiles. Defeat all the rock guys to open the wall to the West and 
    ROOM #24.

subject: ROOM #23
text: In ROOM #23, you can activate one of the tiles to get four hearts.

evidence.quote: ROOM #23: ... You can also activate one of the tiles to get four hearts.

subject: armored knight
text: In ROOM #24, defeat the one armored knight and two regular knights to open the wall to the North and ROOM #25.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #24:
    There is one armored knight and two regular knights in this room. 
    Defeat all of them to open the wall to the North and ROOM #25.

subject: big green blobs
text: In ROOM #25, defeat the two big green blobs to open the door to the North and ROOM #26.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #25:
    There are two big green blobs in this room and a medicine. Defeat 
    the blobs to open the door to the North and ROOM #26.

subject: ROOM #25
text: In ROOM #25, grab the medicine in the room.

evidence.quote: ROOM #25: There are two big green blobs in this room and a medicine.

subject: Dragon
text: In ROOM #26, defeat boss Dragon by jumping up and firing at his head in midair before spikes fill the room to open the door to the East and ROOM #27.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #26: BOSS: Dragon
    This is boss Dragon room. It took me forever to figure out that 
    you have to hit his head by jumping up and firing in midair. Don't 
    wait for him to breathe fire as this will take too long as the 
    spikes start to fill up the room....Defeat him to open the door to 
    the East and ROOM #27.

subject: ROOM #27
text: In ROOM #27, take the exit to the North back to the overworld.

evidence.quote:
ROOm #27:
    Take the exit to the North back to the overworld.

subject: Inside the Dragon Cave
text: In Inside the Dragon Cave, grab the last Tetrad just North of Mike to reach full health.

evidence.quote:
We find Mike back in the cave with a Tetrad just North of him. Grab 
    the last tetrad and now Mike should be at full health.

subject: Inside the Dragon Cave
text: Exit the cave to the Northeast, talk to Mica, then Mike opens the book and says the magic words to travel to Chapter 9.

evidence.quote:
Exit the cave to the Northeast. Mica 
    then tells you to join her at C-island. Mike then opens the book, 
    says the magic words and is zipped off to the next chapter.

subject: little kid
text: In CoralCola on C-island, a little kid tells Mike that all of the villagers are now boars.

evidence.quote:
Back on C-island we find Mike. Hurry to CoralCola. There are a lot 
    more boars here than there used to be. Eventually you will find a 
    little kid who will tell you that all of the villagers are now boars.

subject: CoralCola
text: In CoralCola, take the stairs behind the little kid to enter Coracola Cave.

evidence.quote:
Eventually you will find a 
    little kid who will tell you that all of the villagers are now boars. 
    Take the stairs behind him.

subject: CORACOLA CAVE
text: The layout map for CORACOLA CAVE shows room connections from ROOM #1 through ROOM #28, with ROOM #11 as BOSS Serpent.

evidence.quote: LEGEND FOR CORACOLA CAVE 1 = Starting Point for CORACOLA CAVE 11 = BOSS Serpent [27]-[28] [26] | [25] | [24] [23] | [21]-[22] | [20]

subject: ROOM #1
text: In ROOM #1, take the passage to the North to ROOM #2.

evidence.quote:
ROOm #1:
    Take the passage to the North to ROOM #2.

subject: pink blobs
text: In ROOM #2, defeat the three pink blobs to open the passageway to the North and ROOM #3.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #2:
    There are three pink blobs in this room. Defeat them to open the 
    passageway to the North and ROOM #3.

subject: ROOM #2
text: In ROOM #2, there are two sets of four hearts.

evidence.quote:
There are also two sets of 
    four hearts in this room.

subject: pink blobs
text: In ROOM #3, defeat a certain random blob out of the six pink blobs to open the door to the North and ROOM #4.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #3:
    There are six pink blobs in this room. You only need to defeat a 
    certain random blob to open the door to the North and ROOM #4.

subject: tile
text: In ROOM #4, navigate past several small blue rats heading East, then hop on tiles back West to activate the tile opening the door to the North and ROOM #5.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #4:
    There are several blue small rats in this room. Make your way East 
    until you need to hop on tiles back West. Activate the tile to open 
    the door to the North and ROOM #5.

subject: purple bats and blue rats
text: In ROOM #5, defeat the two purple bats and three blue rats to open the door to the North and ROOM #6.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #5:
    There are two purple bats and three blue rats in this room. Defeat 
    them to open the door to the North and ROOM #6.

subject: ROOM #6
text: In ROOM #6, activate the tiles among the spike balls to get four hearts and open the door to the North and ROOM #7.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #6:
    There are spike balls in the middle of this room. Activate the 
    tiles in this room to get four hearts and to open the door to the 
    North and ROOM #7.

subject: tiles
text: In ROOM #7, one tile opens the door to the North and ROOM #9, while the other tile opens the wall to the East and ROOM #8.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #7:
    There are two purple asps and two pink blobs in this room. There 
    are also two tiles in this room that open the door to the North and 
    ROOM #9 and the other opens the wall to the East and ROOm #8.

subject: ROOM #8
text: In ROOM #8, there is a medicine and a tile that opens the wall to the North and ROOM #9.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #8:
    There is a medicine in this room and a tile that opens the wall to 
    the North and ROOM #9

subject: ROOM #9
text: In ROOM #9, an island in the middle of the room contains two hearts, a medicine, and a random life sign.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #9:
    This room has an island in the middle of the room with two hearts, 
    a medicine, and a random life sign.

subject: ROOM #9
text: From ROOM #9, head back to ROOM #8, ROOM #7, and then North to ROOM #10.

evidence.quote:
Then head back to 
    ROOM #8, ROOM #7, and then North to ROOM #10.

subject: bats and asps
text: In ROOM #10, defeat the three bats and two asps quickly to open the door to the North and ROOM #11.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #10:
    This room has three bats and two asps. Defeat them quickly to open 
    the door to the North and ROOM #11.

subject: C-Serpent
text: In ROOM #11, defeat the boss C-Serpent by avoiding its shots and hitting its head when its mouth is open, which makes a platform appear to proceed North to ROOM #12.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #11: BOSS: C-Serpent
    This is the old C-Serpent from the first game. Now it is only the 
    bones. Just avoid the shots and hit the head when the mouth is 
    open. When you defeat it a platform will appear allowing you to 
    proceed forward North to ROOM #12.

subject: ROOM #12
text: In ROOM #12, take the path East to ROOM #13.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #12:
    Nothing much to do here except take the path East to ROOM #13.

subject: ROOM #13
text: In ROOM #13, tiles forming an arrow lead to one of three conveyor belt paths to ROOM #14.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #13:
    This room has a bunch of tiles forming an arrow that leads to one 
    of three conveyor belt paths. Take any one of these to ROOM #14.

subject: conveyor belts
text: Rooms 14 through 18 are connected by conveyor belts with hearts and medicines, eventually dropping you into ROOM #19.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #14 - ROOM #15 - ROOM #16 - ROOM #17 - ROOM #18:
    All of these rooms are connected by the conveyor belt. Move along 
    them collecting hearts and medicines. Try to avoid hitting any 
    spikes. Eventually all the conveyor belts will drop you in 
    ROOM #19.

subject: ROOM #19
text: As soon as you enter ROOM #19, you fall through the floor to ROOM #20.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #19:
    As soon as you enter this room you fall through the floor to 
    ROOM #20.

subject: ROOM #20
text: In ROOM #20, a tile in the middle of the greyscale room appears and allows the door to the North to open to ROOM #21.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #20
    This is a greyscale room that appears to have no way out. 
    Eventually a tile in the middle of the room will appear and allow 
    the door to the North to open to ROOM #21.

subject: Yum Yum
text: In ROOM #21, defeat boss Yum Yum to open the door to the East and ROOM #22.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #21: BOSS: Yum Yum
    Yum Yum is in this room. However unlike last time he will not be 
    eating a boar. Use the same technique that you used last time to 
    defeat him and open the door to the East and ROOM #22.

subject: Scorpion
text: In ROOM #22, defeat the scorpion boss while avoiding little scorpions to open the door to the North and ROOM #23.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #22: BOSS: Scorpion
    This room has the scorpion boss from Egypt. Just avoid the little 
    scorpions and you should have no trouble defeating him which opens 
    the door to the North and ROOM #23.

subject: Pharoah
text: In ROOM #23, defeat the Pharoah mask boss while avoiding his blasts to fall through the floor to ROOM #24.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #23: BOSS: Pharoah
    The pharoah mask boss is in this room. Defeat him while avoiding 
    his blasts to fall through the floor to ROOM #24.

subject: Zoda-X
text: In ROOM #24, defeat Zoda-X while avoiding getting hit on the conveyor belt to open the door to the North and ROOM #25.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #24: BOSS: Zoda-X
    The random conveyor belt in this room should remind you of Zoda-X. 
    Try to avoid getting hit and defeat him to open the door to the 
    North and ROOM #25.

subject: Skeleton Miner
text: In ROOM #25, defeat the Skeleton Miner to open the door to the North and ROOM #26.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #25: BOSS: Skeleton Miner
    The Skeleton Miner is in this room. Defeat him the same way you 
    beat him last time to open the door to the North and ROOM #26.

subject: Zoda-Y
text: In ROOM #26, defeat Zoda-Y, who transforms into a bird halfway through the battle, to fall through the floor to ROOM #27.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #26: BOSS: Zoda-Y
    This room has Zoda-Y. Zoda-Y will transform into a bird halfway 
    thorough the battle. Defeat him to fall through the floor to 
    ROOM #27.

subject: Dragon
text: In ROOM #27, defeat the dragon by hitting his head while jumping in the air to open the door to the East and ROOM #28.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #27: BOSS: Dragon
    The dragon is in this room. Just remember to hit his head by 
    jumping in the air. Defeat him to open the door to the East 
    and ROOM #28.

subject: ROOM #28
text: In ROOM #28, one appearing tile reveals a pill and another opens the door to the North and ROOM #29.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #28:
    There are two tiles that will eventually appear in this room. One 
    will make a pill appear. The other will open the door to the North 
    and ROOM #29.

subject: Zoda-Z
text: In ROOM #29, defeat Zoda-Z by shooting the off-color ball among four balls, then defeating his true form and final form to open the door to the West and ROOM #30.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #29:
    This room has Zoda-Z. Initially he will appear as four little Zoda 
    balls. Shoot at the off color ball until it is defeated and Zoda-Z 
    appears. After several shots he will transform into his true form.
    After several more shots he will move into his final form. Defeat 
    both forms to open the door to the West and ROOM #30.

subject: ROOM #30
text: ROOM #30 contains an exit to the North.

evidence.quote:
ROOM #30:
    Just an exit to the North.

subject: Mica
text: Back inside Coracola Cave, head North to find Mica, who instructs Mike to check on the villagers.

evidence.quote:
Back inside of the cave head North and eventually find Mica. She 
    tells you there are many stories to tell you but first you must 
    check on the villagers.

subject: Chief
text: At the chief's hut in the village, the Chief puts the tetrads together to resemble a maple leaf, causing Hiricon to appear.

evidence.quote:
Head to the chief's hut. Mica will join you there and tell 
    you that you saved everyone. She then helps you assemble the 
    tetrads. Then talk to the Chief. He will agree to assist you and
    puts them together to resemble a maple leaf. Once assembled Hiricon 
    appears and thanks you for saving him.

subject: Hiricon
text: Hiricon bestows 'Hero of Aragonia' upon Mike before turning into a ball of light and flying off the island.

evidence.quote:
Hiricon then bestows upon Mike "Hero of 
    Aragonia". They all turn into balls of light and fly off the island 
    into the sky.

subject: Two Hearts
text: Two Hearts restores Mike's health by two.

evidence.quote: Two Hearts: Mike's health restored by two.

subject: Four Hearts
text: Four Hearts restores Mike's health by four.

evidence.quote: Four Hearts: Mike's health restored by four.

subject: Star
text: When you get 5 Star items in a dungeon, health is restored by one.

evidence.quote: Star: When you get 5 of these in a dungeon you restore health by one.

subject: Random-Life Sign
text: The Random-Life Sign allows Mike to take a chance to gain or lose lives.

evidence.quote: Random-Life Sign: Take a chance to gain or lose lives.

subject: Chicken Nuggets
text: Chicken Nuggets are found in Old West caves and restore health to Mike.

evidence.quote: Chicken Nuggets: Found in Old West caves. Restores health to Mike.

subject: Pill
text: The Pill gives Mike a full twenty hearts.

evidence.quote:
Pill: This will give Mike a full twenty hearts. Acts sames as in first 
 game.

subject: Big Heart
text: The Big Heart increases Mike's number of hearts by one permanently.

evidence.quote: Big Heart: Mike's number of hearts increased by one permanently.

subject: Medicine
text: Medicine restores Mike's health by five.

evidence.quote: Medicine: Mike's health restored by five.

subject: Flute
text: The Flute is found and used in the Egyptian Pyramid to make asps visible.

evidence.quote: Flute: Found and used in Egyptian Pyramid. Makes asps visible.

subject: Dynamite
text: Dynamite is used to blow open caves in the side of mountains in Old West.

evidence.quote: Dynamite: Used to blow open caves in the side of mountains in Old West.

subject: Gold Nugget
text: The Gold Nugget can be sold in town to Bob for points in Old West.

evidence.quote: Gold Nugget: Can be sold in town to Bob for points in Old West.

subject: Chisel
text: Mike uses the Chisel to get Leonardo Da Vinci free.

evidence.quote: Chisel: Mike uses this to get Leonardo Da Vinci free.

subject: Tetrad
text: Tetrad items are found at the end of each chapter.

evidence.quote: Tetrad: These are found at the end of each chapter. Collect them all.

subject: Axes
text: You get Axes from a cave man named Tink in the Ice Age Chapter.

evidence.quote: Axes: You get these from a cave man named Tink in the Ice Age Chapter.

subject: Daggers
text: Daggers are an upgrade to axes, given by Cleopatra in Egypt Chapter.

evidence.quote: Daggers: An upgrade to your axes, given by Cleopatra in Egypt Chapter.

subject: Katana
text: The Katana is an upgrade to daggers, given by Leonardo Da Vinci in Venice.

evidence.quote: Katana: An upgrade to your daggers, given by Leonardo Da Vinci in Venice.

subject: Psychic Shockwave
text: A monkey in an Egyptian Savannah teaches Psychic Shockwave to Mike.

evidence.quote: Psychic Shockwave: A monkey in an Egyptian Savannah teaches this to you.

subject: Super Psychic Shockwave
text: A donkey in the Wild West teaches Super Psychic Shockwave to Mike.

evidence.quote: Super Psychic Shockwave: A donkey in the Wild West teaches this to you.

subject: Ultra Psychic Shockwave
text: Merlin in Camelot teaches Ultra Psychic Shockwave to Mike, which requires at least 10 hearts.

evidence.quote:
Ultra Psychic Shockwave: Merlin in Camelot teaches this to you. You will 
need at least 10 hearts to have this ability.

subject: Rocks
text: Rocks are the first weapon in the game, described as weak but useful, and are found in Ice Age.

evidence.quote:
Rocks: The first weapon in the game. Very weak but useful. Found in Ice 
Age.

subject: Slingshot
text: The slingshot is first found in Egypt and is more powerful than rocks.

evidence.quote:
Slingshot: A little more powerful than rocks and travels a little 
further.
The slingshot is first found in Egypt.

subject: Spiked Frisbees
text: Spiked Frisbees are found in Scotland Yard and shoot little frisbees a short distance.

evidence.quote:
Spiked Frisbees: Shoots little frisbees a short distance. Found in 
Scotland Yard.

subject: Stars
text: Stars are first found in Old West and inflict good damage.

evidence.quote:
Stars: Shoot these to inflict good damage. These are first found in Old 
West.

subject: Spike Balls
text: Spike Balls are first found in Transylvania and fire a spread shot in three directions.

evidence.quote:
Spike Balls: These do a spread shot in three directions. These are first
found in Transylvania.

subject: BOARS
text: BOARS are found in the caves of the Ice Age, requiring two hits with stones or one hit with the axe.

evidence.quote:
BOARS: One of the first enemies in the game. You first find these guys 
in the caves of the Ice Age. When you first meet them you have stones 
and they require to hits, but once you find the axe they can be taken 
out in one hit.

subject: LIZARDS
text: LIZARDS are found in the ICE AGE and require two hits of the axe.

evidence.quote:
LIZARDS: These guys are also found in the ICE AGE. They require two 
hits of the axe.

subject: BLUE BEAR
text: BLUE BEAR is found in the ice age and requires hits from the axe.

evidence.quote:
BLUE BEAR: FOund in the ice age. These guys require X number of hits 
from the axe.

subject: YELLOW BEAR
text: YELLOW BEAR is more powerful than the BLUE BEAR and requires more hits from the axe.

evidence.quote:
YELLOW BEAR: More powerful than the BLUE BEAR, these require even more 
hits from the axe.

subject: SNOW MEN
text: SNOW MEN are white and require several hits to defeat them.

evidence.quote:
SNOW MEN: I am not sure if they are snow men or not but they are white 
and require several hits to defeat them.

subject: SPIDERS
text: SPIDERS in Egyptian caves shoot little balls and are defeated with two hits from the axe.

evidence.quote:
SPIDERS: We first encounter these in the Egyptian caves. The can shoot 
little balls so watch out. Two hits from the axe will take them out.

subject: CYCLOPS
text: CYCLOPS carry daggers and are eliminated by a couple shots of the axe.

evidence.quote:
CYCLOPS: These guys carry daggers and attack similar to the BEARS. A 
couple shots of the axe they will be no more.

subject: PORCUPINES
text: PORCUPINES in Egypt are invincible once rolled into a ball and must be attacked when not rolled into a ball.

evidence.quote:
PORCUPINES: These creatures are invicible once they have rolled into a 
ball. You must attack them when they are not rolled into a ball. We 
first find them in Egypt.

subject: SCORPIONS
text: SCORPIONS in Egypt require two shots to defeat.

evidence.quote: SCORPIONS: Average enemeny you meet in Egypt. Just requires two shots.

subject: UNDERGROUND ENEMY
text: UNDERGROUND ENEMY is found in Egypt and their faces are never seen.

evidence.quote:
UNDERGROUND ENEMY: I am not sure if this is the best name for these 
guys. We never see their faces and find them in Egypt.

subject: BLUE FROGS
text: BLUE FROGS hop around and cause mischief but are easy to encounter.

evidence.quote:
BLUE FROGS: These guys can hop around and cause mischief but generally 
are easy to encounter.

subject: CROCODILE
text: CROCODILE enemies are long but slow and easy to defeat, similar to Lizards from the Ice Age.

evidence.quote:
CROCODILE: These are similar to the LIZARDS from the Ice Age. Long but 
slow and relatively easy to defeat.

subject: WHITE JELLYFISH
text: WHITE JELLYFISH levitate over the surface and are easy to defeat.

evidence.quote:
WHITE JELLYFISH: Somehow these jellyfish have acquired the ability to 
levitate over the surface. However, they are easy to defeat and 
shouldn't pose much problem.

subject: HIPPOPATAMUS
text: HIPPOPATAMUS hides in the water, pops its head up, and fires two shots.

evidence.quote:
HIPPOPATAMUS: These are generally hiding in the water when you first 
enter the room. They will pop their head up and fire two shots at you.

subject: SWANS
text: SWANS shoot at Mike once every few moments and require a few shots to defeat.

evidence.quote:
SWANS: Somehow these swans have the ability to shoot at you once every 
few moments. They are not very difficult but require a few shots to 
defeat.

subject: LADYBUGS
text: LADYBUGS wear skull masks and are defeated by a couple shots from the dagger.

evidence.quote:
LADYBUGS: I am not sure if they are ladybugs or not but their backs 
have colors similar to the ladybug. Their skull masks make them look 
frightening but a couple of shots from your dagger and they will be 
toast.

subject: ASPS
text: ASPS are snakes; do not get in the way of their charges.

evidence.quote:
ASPS: Similar to other snakes in the game. Just don't get in the way 
of their charges and you should be able to defeat them without much 
effort.

subject: PYRAMID GUARDS
text: PYRAMID GUARDS are slow and immune to daggers, requiring psychic shockwave to defeat.

evidence.quote:
PYRAMID GUARDS: They are slow but are immune to daggers. You need to 
use your psychic shockwave to defeat them.

subject: AMAN-RA GUARDIAN
text: AMAN-RA GUARDIAN slowly walks around and every once in awhile flashes and shoots two fireballs.

evidence.quote:
AMAN-RA GUARDIAN: I don't know if this is the best description for 
these guys but they remind me of the drwaings of Aman-Ra so I named 
them thus. They are moderately difficult to defeat. They just slowly 
walk around and every once in awhile flash and shoot two fireballs.

subject: YELLOW JELLYFISH
text: YELLOW JELLYFISH take twice as many shots to defeat as the White Jellyfish.

evidence.quote:
YELLOW JELLYFISH: Just like the White Jellyfish only they take twice 
as many shots to defeat.

subject: RED FROGS
text: RED FROGS take twice as many hits to defeat as Blue Frogs.

evidence.quote:
RED FROGS: These frogs are just like their Blue Frog ancestors only 
they take twice as many hits to defeat.

subject: SMALL RATS
text: SMALL RATS are similar to Boars or Scorpions and dangerous in numbers.

evidence.quote:
SMALL RATS: Similar to Boars or Scorpions. Just be careful of them in 
numbers.

subject: LARGE RATS
text: LARGE RATS take several hits to defeat and move around similar to Small Rats.

evidence.quote:
LARGE RATS: These guys take several hits to defeat but move around 
similar to the Small Rats.

subject: BLUE BLOB
text: BLUE BLOB jumps in the air and can generally only be hit when falling back to the ground.

evidence.quote:
BLUE BLOB: These are tricky to defeat because they jump in the air and 
you will generally only be able to hit them only when they fall back to 
the ground.

subject: OWLS
text: OWLS are always airborne, so attack them from a column or jump and attack them.

evidence.quote:
OWLS: These fly around similar to the jellyfish except you can hit the 
jellyfish at ground level. Owls are always airborn so either attack 
them from a cloumn or jump and attack them.
